[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 15
- Description: Cristiano (CIC) follow-up — heavy metal reports still outstanding, China side waiting; production cost query opened
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1835
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1836
  
  Details:
  15-minute follow-up with Cristiano at CIC, escalating the outstanding heavy-metal lab reports and opening the production-cost question for the Chinese market.
  
  === WHAT WAS SAID (verified from the screenshot across multiple OCR passes) ===
  WhatsApp thread "Cristiano - CIC...", 9:13-9:14 AM, from the governor:
    1. "By the way, we are still waiting for the heavy metal lab reports for the six samples we dropped off in September can you please help check. China side is waiting for it"  [9:13 AM]
    2. "How much does such a box cost to produce?"  — followed by a truncated line reading "China might be interes..." (almost certainly "interested" but the line is cut, so NOT asserted as complete)
    3. "By the way, this is the photo taken of me and the food distributor based here in China. His name is also Cristiano"  [9:14 AM]
    Also visible in the thread, a quoted/reply line: "you were to just sell the chocolates?"
  
  === TWO CRISTIANOS — a real disambiguation hazard, flagged before it bites ===
  The message explicitly states: Cristiano at **CIC** is a different person from the **food distributor based in China**, whose name is *also* Cristiano. So this thread now involves two people sharing one first name, in the same commercial channel.
  
  This is exactly the failure mode that produced an incorrect ledger entry earlier in this same thread (a 3-hour SKU session was filed attributing the wrong phone number and region to Nathan because two WeChat profiles were assumed to be one person). Recording it here deliberately so the next filing does not merge them: **Cristiano-CIC is the testing/lab-side contact. Cristiano-China is the distributor.** Any future contribution or outreach note must name which one.
  
  "**CIC**" is being read as **Cacao Innovation Center** — the same organisation as Bianca, who has been separately chased for these same reports (filed 20 Nov). That reading is consistent with the governor's own phrasing ("Cristiano from CIC") and with the parallel Bianca thread titled "Cacao Innovation C...", but the abbreviation is not spelled out in the screenshot, so it is an inference rather than a verified expansion.
  
  === WHY THIS ESCALATION MATTERS MORE THAN THE PREVIOUS ONES ===
  Earlier follow-ups (Bianca, 20 Nov) recorded that the six September samples were outstanding and that the reports gate every regulated channel. This message changes the *commercial* position, not just the administrative one:
  
    - **"China side is waiting for it."** The dependency has moved from an internal chase to an external buyer's market waiting on documentation. That puts a third party's timeline on our critical path — a materially harder situation than "we are still waiting".
    - The same message asks **"How much does such a box cost to produce?"** — so the counterparty is actively sizing unit economics. Costing is being asked for *before* the compliance paper exists. That is workable, but it must be clearly conditional: quoting a production cost implies a deliverable, and delivering requires heavy-metal clearance.
    - **A photo of the governor with the China-based distributor was shared** in the same thread, and the distributor was named. That converts the China channel from an abstract "China market" into an identified counterparty — the step where informal interest usually either crystallises into a real order or quietly evaporates.
  
  === THE SEQUENCING POINT WORTH STATING PLAINLY ===
  Three separate chases now exist on the same six samples: Bianca (CIC), Cristiano (CIC), and the China side waiting downstream. Chasing twice at the same organisation risks the lab treating it as one low-priority item being re-sent rather than a deadline. The more effective move is a single request that:
    - names the **six sample IDs** from the September drop-off, so results map to specific bags/lots and can carry through QR lineage, rather than a generic "all passed" certificate;
    - asks for a **committed date**, not an assurance;
    - is addressed to both Bianca and Cristiano so the org has one visible owner rather than two parallel threads.
  The NFSe service invoice already seen in the Bianca thread (NFSe 0097, Venda 120634) indicates the testing is contracted and invoiced — so this is a throughput/scheduling problem to press, not a payment dispute.
  
  === DEPENDENCY CHAIN (unchanged, now with a third party) ===
  5 g Chinese-market product line → Chinese labelling (GB 7718 / GB 28050, cocoa-solids per GB/T 19343) → **heavy-metal clearance** → six September lab reports (pending) → now blocking a named distributor who is asking for production cost. Mould sourcing (PCB209 / CW12103 / QL-1585, filed separately) was never the bottleneck at any point in this chain.
  
  === TIME BASIS ===
  15 minutes as directed by the governor. TDG derived from the dao_client rubric SSOT (rubric.py: Time (Minutes) = minutes/60*100 = 15/60*100 = **25.00**), not supplied by hand.
  
  === DUPLICATE CHECK ===
  Searched the autopilot service log from 2026-11-01 for "cristiano" among create_dao_submission calls. **Zero** matches — this follow-up has not been filed before.
  
  === EVIDENCE ===
  cristiano_cic_heavy_metal_china_followup_2026-11-20.png — the WhatsApp thread screenshot, attached. Auto-OCR reported 79% confidence; re-read independently at psm 4 and psm 6 in both English and Portuguese before filing. The English text quoted above was recovered consistently across all passes. Two fragments are explicitly NOT asserted as complete: the "China might be interes..." line (truncated at the edge) and the "you were to just sell the chocolates?" line (quoted text, context only).
  
  PR FIELD NOTE: operational follow-up with no code change, so no PR of its own. The two PR URLs cited carry PDF/markdown artefact work from this same thread and are included only because the reporting tool requires a pull URL and rejects non-pull links.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 25.00
- Attached Filename: cristiano_cic_heavy_metal_china_followup_2026-11-20.png
- Destination Contribution File Location: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/tree/main/assets/cristiano_cic_heavy_metal_china_followup_2026-11-20.png
